name: Morningbelle
source:
You recently got a job working the graveyard shift at… a graveyard.

In the small town of Wisperell, nothing much ever happens. This year’s Halloween is looking to be no different, that is, until you meet a mysterious ghost named Noel after cleaning an abandoned grave during your shift.

Thus, you’re now begrudgingly roped into a quest to help Noel pass on peacefully by Halloween night.

Except, why does it seem like there’s something underneath the surface of it all? Your coworker’s on edge for some reason, Noel can’t seem to remember anything, and you’re finding more information about Wisperell than you intended to.

Maybe some secrets are better off buried in the past.

[From [url=https://wednesday888.itch.io/morningbelle]itch.io[/url]]
